ai.purpose: RTT structural map of the paper 'Parity of k-differentials in genus zero and one'.
ai.module.summary: This module exposes the regime structure underlying parity phenomena in k-differentials for genus 0 and 1. It preserves the authors' mathematical results while adding RTT operators for agentic reasoning.

combinatorial_parity_regime.description: Parity determined by combinatorial data of zeros/poles and k-residue constraints.
combinatorial_parity_regime.evidence: Paper classifies parity via discrete invariants of k-differentials.

geometric_strata_regime.description: Behavior depends on the geometry of strata in moduli spaces of k-differentials.
geometric_strata_regime.evidence: Authors analyze strata structure in genus 0 and 1.

genus_transition_regime.description: Genus 0 and genus 1 exhibit distinct parity behavior due to topological constraints.
genus_transition_regime.evidence: Paper separates results by genus and proves different criteria.

local_vs_global_parity.description: Local zero/pole data vs global topological constraints on differentials.
local_vs_global_parity.paper_alignment: Parity classification depends on both local orders and global genus.

combinatorial_vs_geometric.description: Discrete invariants vs geometric structure of moduli strata.
combinatorial_vs_geometric.paper_alignment: Authors combine combinatorial and geometric arguments.

genus_zero_vs_genus_one.description: Different parity rules emerge from different topologies.
genus_zero_vs_genus_one.paper_alignment: Paper proves separate theorems for g=0 and g=1.

strata_refinement_transition.description: Moving between strata changes parity classification.
strata_refinement_transition.paper_alignment: Authors analyze how strata boundaries affect parity.

genus_lift_transition.description: Transition from genus 0 to genus 1 introduces new parity phenomena.
genus_lift_transition.paper_alignment: Paper highlights new behaviors in genus 1.

combinatorial_to_geometric_transition.description: Parity criteria shift from purely combinatorial to geometric as genus increases.
combinatorial_to_geometric_transition.paper_alignment: Authors use geometric arguments in genus 1.

parity_operator.role: Computes parity from zero/pole data and k-residue constraints.

strata_operator.role: Identifies geometric strata relevant to parity classification.

genus_operator.role: Encodes topological constraints that differentiate genus 0 and 1 behavior.

ai.audience: Researchers in algebraic geometry, flat surfaces, and moduli theory.
